A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown how to use neural networks for the task of topic modelling.
we have developed a novel deep neural autoregressive topic model that can be trained on raw texts, without requiring pre-trained word vectors.
we have developed a new neural topic model, textTOvec, that is capable of learning topics from a corpus of documents, and can generate new documents from these learned topics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a neural model can be trained in a way that is similar to a standard topic model, while also allowing for the use of word embeddings.
the use of deep contextualized word representations can significantly improve topic coherence and quality, especially for longer documents.
the contextualized embeddings from BERT can be used to model the latent topics in text.
